children: Cascadia Minerals Ltd. (V.CAM) Hit a 52-Week High of 42 cents. Cascadia announced drill results this week from its Carmacks Gold project in Yukon. Hole CD-26-056 at Zone 2000S returned: 82.69 m of 1.12% copper with 0.64 g/t gold (1.78% CuEq), including 49.16 m of 1.63% copper with 0.95 g/t gold (2.62% CuEq).
Vertical Exploration Inc. (V.VERT) Hit a 52-Week High of three cents. No news stories available today.

Cerrado Gold (T.CG) Hit a 52-Week High of $2.62. Cerrado Gold has closed the previously announced strategic non-brokered private placement financing with Eric Sprott for aggregate gross proceeds of $10 million.

Carlin Gold Corp (V.CGD) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.57. This week, Carlin reports the following changes to management, effective September 1. Dong Shim has been appointed Chief Financial Officer and Marla Ritchie, has been appointed Corporate Secretary. Aris Morfopoulos is resigning as Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary effective August 31 to pursue other opportunities.
CMX Gold & Silver Corp. (C.CXC) Hit a 52-Week High of 30 cents. No news stories available today.

EDM Resources Inc (V. EDM) Hit a 52-Week High of 76 cents. Early last month, EDM has received an amended Industrial Approval from Nova Scotia's Department of Environment and Climate Change for its Scotia Mine, clearing the way for the company's updated mine plan and processing facility ahead of a planned restart.

title: Cascadia, Vertical, Cerrado at 52-Week Highs on News
